raw_response: {"diagnosis": "raw_customers holds a mix of region names (SOUTH/WEST/NORTH/EAST) and numeric region codes ('01'-'04') for 60 customers, and silver_customers passes the codes through unmapped. raw_region_map is a complete one-to-one lookup from those four codes to the four valid region names, so the codes can be translated deterministically.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.85, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_customers": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_customers AS SELECT c.customer_id, upper(COALESCE(m.region_name, c.region)) AS region FROM raw_customers c LEFT JOIN raw_region_map m ON trim(c.region) = trim(m.region_code)"}}
